notes.text: **Choosing a word only sets start and end.** Dragging, clicking a first and last letter and the arrow keys all end up there, then a try message checks the live `hit`.
notes.author: Example

notes.text: **Two lists make two puzzles.** `words` (the word search) and `clues` (the crossword, called `words` in its starter) are the only things changed. Change a word in the Variables tab and its grid changes.
notes.author: Example

notes.text: **The grids are formulas.** `rows` is `wordSearch(words, 12)` and `entries` is `crossword(clues, 10)`, both kept up to date. The repeaters draw one square per letter.
notes.author: Example

notes.text: **Typing fills cells.** Each square remembers what was typed (`t`) beside its answer letter (`ch`), so Check compares the two and the live `done` notices the last right letter.
notes.author: Example

variables.name: line
variables.formula: start < 0 || end < 0 ? [] : (Math.floor(start / 12) == Math.floor(end / 12) || (start % 12) == (end % 12) || Math.abs(Math.floor(end / 12) - Math.floor(start / 12)) == Math.abs((end % 12) - (start % 12))) ? Array.from({length: Math.max(Math.abs(Math.floor(end / 12) - Math.floor(start / 12)), Math.abs((end % 12) - (start % 12))) + 1}, (_, k) => (Math.floor(start / 12) + Math.sign(Math.floor(end / 12) - Math.floor(start / 12)) * k) * 12 + (start % 12) + Math.sign((end % 12) - (start % 12)) * k) : [start]

variables.name: hit
variables.formula: line.length < 2 ? -1 : words.findIndex((w, k) => !found.includes(k) && (w.toUpperCase() == line.map(i => rows.join("").charAt(i)).join("") || w.toUpperCase() == line.map(i => rows.join("").charAt(i)).join("").split("").reverse().join("")))

variables.name: message

variables.name: entries
variables.initial: [{"answer":"SNOW","clue":"Frozen flakes that fall in winter","row":0,"col":3,"down":true},{"answer":"RIVER","clue":"Carries water downhill to the sea","row":2,"col":0,"down":true},{"answer":"CONDENSE","clue":"What vapour does as it cools into droplets","row":2,"col":2,"down":false},{"answer":"STREAM","clue":"A small river","row":2,"col":8,"down":true},{"answer":"VAPOUR","clue":"Water as a gas","row":4,"col":2,"down":true},{"answer":"RAIN","clue":"Water falling from the clouds","row":4,"col":6,"down":true},{"answer":"EVAPORATE","clue":"What water does when the sun turns it into a gas","row":5,"col":0,"down":false},{"answer":"OCEAN","clue":"Holds most of the water on Earth","row":5,"col":4,"down":true},{"answer":"RUNOFF","clue":"Water flowing over the ground into streams","row":9,"col":2,"down":false}]

variables.name: letters
variables.formula: entries.flatMap(e => e.answer.toUpperCase().split("").map((l, k) => ({i: (e.row + (e.down ? k : 0)) * 10 + e.col + (e.down ? 0 : k), l})))

variables.name: starts
variables.formula: entries.map(e => e.row * 10 + e.col).filter((v, i, a) => a.indexOf(v) == i).sort((a, b) => a - b)

variables.name: cells
variables.formula: Array.from({length: 100}, (_, i) => ({r: Math.floor(i / 10), c: i % 10, ch: (letters.find(x => x.i == i) ?? {l: ""}).l, num: starts.indexOf(i) + 1, t: "", s: ""}))

variables.name: acrossClues
variables.formula: entries.map((e, i) => ({i, n: starts.indexOf(e.row * 10 + e.col) + 1, clue: e.clue, len: e.answer.length, down: e.down, start: e.row * 10 + e.col})).filter(x => x.down == false).sort((a, b) => a.n - b.n)

variables.name: downClues
variables.formula: entries.map((e, i) => ({i, n: starts.indexOf(e.row * 10 + e.col) + 1, clue: e.clue, len: e.answer.length, down: e.down, start: e.row * 10 + e.col})).filter(x => x.down == true).sort((a, b) => a.n - b.n)

variables.name: aw
variables.formula: sel < 0 ? -1 : (entries.findIndex(e => e.down == (dir == "down") && (e.down ? (e.col == (sel % 10) && Math.floor(sel / 10) >= e.row && Math.floor(sel / 10) < e.row + e.answer.length) : (e.row == Math.floor(sel / 10) && (sel % 10) >= e.col && (sel % 10) < e.col + e.answer.length))) >= 0 ? entries.findIndex(e => e.down == (dir == "down") && (e.down ? (e.col == (sel % 10) && Math.floor(sel / 10) >= e.row && Math.floor(sel / 10) < e.row + e.answer.length) : (e.row == Math.floor(sel / 10) && (sel % 10) >= e.col && (sel % 10) < e.col + e.answer.length))) : entries.findIndex(e => (e.down ? (e.col == (sel % 10) && Math.floor(sel / 10) >= e.row && Math.floor(sel / 10) < e.row + e.answer.length) : (e.row == Math.floor(sel / 10) && (sel % 10) >= e.col && (sel % 10) < e.col + e.answer.length))))

variables.name: wordCells
variables.formula: aw < 0 ? [] : Array.from({length: entries[aw].answer.length}, (_, k) => (entries[aw].row + (entries[aw].down ? k : 0)) * 10 + entries[aw].col + (entries[aw].down ? 0 : k))

variables.name: current
variables.formula: aw < 0 ? "Select a square, then type." : (starts.indexOf(entries[aw].row * 10 + entries[aw].col) + 1) + (entries[aw].down ? " down: " : " across: ") + entries[aw].clue + " (" + entries[aw].answer.length + ")"

variables.name: status
variables.formula: notice != "" ? notice : done ? "Crossword complete. Well done!" : ""
